item: sqlcipher3 0.6.4 (SQLCipher 4.19) qualified, ceiling lifted to <0.6.5, a CI lane for the floor and the newest engine
summary: The damage lane classifies correctly under 4.19 (the observer already discards on code 11; salvage and the bundle rollback never read the class); one change, transient with the production defaults: a damaged last overflow page now latches the file with one class-only incident, which the automatic re-read of the (healthy) statement's tables releases at once, the incident ending superseded as clean (pinned with re-reads on). The two page-damage test files pin both engines by measuring the engine, nothing skipped or loosened; fixtures written by each engine prove stores open both ways; the sqlcipher-engines job runs those files plus the compat file and seven other damage files on the floor (blocking) and the newest release (observation); lock, smoke pin, pyproject ceiling and registry moved together.
